input.prompt: A hand-drawn cinematic storyboard panel, monochrome graphite and grey marker on paper, loose confident film-storyboard style with hatching. Content: a HIGH WIDE shot looking down and across the concourse of a large old railway station at evening rush hour. A huge arched steel-and-glass trainshed roof with rows of hanging pendant lamps. A large rectangular departure board hangs above the centre of the concourse with a round clock beneath it. A coffee kiosk on the left, a thick cylindrical stone column mid-concourse, numbered platform gates along the far side. A dense crowd of commuters drawn as loose grey shapes. In the lower LEFT foreground a tall man in a light-toned jacket walks toward the RIGHT, with a bold arrow drawn beside him pointing right. On the RIGHT side of frame, further back in depth, a woman in a dark coat walks toward the LEFT, with a bold arrow drawn beside her pointing left. Only these two figures are drawn with clean detail; everyone else is loose. Storyboard sketch only, no colour, no photograph. No text, no numbers, no labels, no captions.
